safety.description: Hazard to people or goods (leak, spill, out-of-range perishable). Human safety authority takes over; the agent relays facts and gives no handling or consumption advice.
safety.channel_rule: Safety incident queue (carrier) or the merchant food-safety lead by email; never a driver or the customer

investigations.description: A record and a party statement conflict (delivered scan vs no receipt; failed-attempt scan vs customer at home). The owner reviews its own record; no fraud, loss or liability conclusion is drawn by the agent.
investigations.human_gate: hard for delivered-not-received; soft for attempt disputes
investigations.channel_rule: Email to the carrier review/investigation team
investigations.sla: register same day; follow up at the next-update time the team gives

billing_review.description: Any charge, credit, refund or guarantee amount. The desk cannot set prices, waive, pay or multiply amounts; it relays the request with timestamps and terms.
billing_review.human_gate: hard when an amount is to be credited; none for a pure explanation
billing_review.channel_rule: Email to the owning billing team; reply to the customer in the verified order thread without payment links
billing_review.sla: same day; follow up on the billing team's stated date

urgent_cutoff.description: A hard cutoff within hours (driver waiting at the gate, return-to-sender at 16:00, next outbound sweep). Missing it is irreversible.
urgent_cutoff.human_gate: none, but escalate to a human if the party does not answer before the cutoff
urgent_cutoff.channel_rule: Call or chat/work queue, never email
urgent_cutoff.sla: act within minutes; verify before the cutoff

awaiting_customer.description: The next step needs the customer to choose, confirm or supply something (slot, apartment number, nominee, checklist, photos). The agent asks exactly for that and nothing else.
awaiting_customer.channel_rule: Customer portal (order-linked thread); call only when a cutoff applies
awaiting_customer.sla: wait state with reminder timer; resume on reply

awaiting_counterparty.description: A business shipper, consignee or signatory must supply data or complete a mandate before the carrier can act.
awaiting_counterparty.human_gate: hard when a signing authority is involved (mandate)
awaiting_counterparty.channel_rule: Business portal (verified channel) or email to the named authorised person
awaiting_counterparty.sla: wait state; chase before the carrier slot lapses

merchant_authorisation.description: Replacement, exchange, reshipment, duplicate return, label/token issue, specialist collection, refund review. Only the merchant team with that authority can approve; the agent supplies the accepted evidence and the customer's recorded choice.
merchant_authorisation.channel_rule: Email to the specific merchant team

carrier_trace.description: Physical verification: locate, scan, trace, confirm handover. The agent demands a physical scan or receipt, never a planned or departure status.
carrier_trace.channel_rule: Depot work queue or email to the trace team
carrier_trace.sla: scan expected same day; otherwise escalate to investigations

carrier_ops.description: Routine operator execution within stated policy: rebook, hold, redirect, extension, callback note, transfer, recovery, collection, capacity booking, approved wording.
carrier_ops.human_gate: none unless money or authority flags are present
carrier_ops.channel_rule: Email to the owning carrier team; dispatch chat when the request originates in chat
carrier_ops.sla: confirmation expected within the working day
